title: Stay Connected with FreeTV Garden
body:
We’re continuously improving FreeTV Garden and adding new features, channels, and updates. Stay connected so you never miss an important announcement.

**📢 Get Updates on Telegram**
Follow our official Telegram channel for new features, service updates, channel availability, and important announcements.

👉 [Join the FreeTV Garden Telegram Channel](https://t.me/Freetools_channel)

**💬 Join the Discussion Community**
Want to interact with other users? Join our discussion group to share your experience, discuss channels, ask questions, and exchange suggestions with the community.

👉 [Join the Telegram Discussion Group](https://t.me/aFreetools)

**🛠️ Report an Issue or Suggest a Feature**
Found a channel that isn’t working, incorrect information, a technical issue, or have an idea that could make FreeTV Garden better? We’d love to hear from you.

📧 [contact.freetool@gmail.com](mailto:contact.freetool@gmail.com)

You can also visit [FreeTV Garden](https://freetvgarden.com) for the latest information and updates.

**Your feedback matters.** Every report and suggestion helps us improve FreeTV Garden for everyone.
